issue_context.title: Add default queue sort plugins for scheduler framework
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:

Convert [`activeQComp`](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/internal/queue/scheduling_queue.go#L154) to default queue sort plugin for the QueueSort plugin extension point of the new scheduler framework.

**Why is this needed**:

Most of scheduler plugins has been added in the new framework. We could add default plugin set for them now. We could start from the QueuePlugin.

/sig scheduling

cc @bsalamat @ahg-g

review_comments: If we use `k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/queuesort`.`Name`( "default-queue-sort-plugin"), there will be an import cycle(note that `k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/queuesort` has imported `k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/scheduler/framework/v1alpha1`), so I introduce `frameworkplugins.DefaultQueueSortPluginName` to resolve it.
